trigger.observation: The user reported many black points flickering in the first function-engine visual candidate.

deduplication.novelLayer: N199 covers class/instance/visibility reuse. This case covers numerical sample validity and frozen-input temporal stability.

mustNeverRepeat: non-finite residual, position, depth, gradient, normal or color silently converted into a black surface sample
unconverged function sample shaded as a valid hit
zero or near-zero gradient normalized without an explicit validity check
one global finite-difference epsilon used without function and coordinate scale evidence
frame index or time entering a nominally frozen evaluation without declaration
WGSL derivative operations executed in non-uniform control flow or their diagnostics suppressed

scope.includes: sample-state semantics and a diagnostic gate that can distinguish numerical invalidity from legitimate visibility
excludes: claiming the observed production flicker is already diagnosed
production WebGPU, browser, device, visual or user acceptance

gate.validHit: Require finite point/depth/residual/gradient/normal/color, abs(residual) <= declared scale-aware surface epsilon, gradient norm above threshold, valid depth and unexhausted iteration budget.
gate.invalidSample: Do not shade as a black hit. Preserve the explicit failure state, count it and expose it in a debug state buffer.
gate.cellAmbiguity: A region that may include NaN or crosses the function surface remains AMBIGUOUS; do not promote it directly to HIT.
gate.temporalRepeat: With camera, parameters, time and noise seed frozen, eight repeated frames must have identical state/depth/normal hashes.
gate.derivatives: Reject derivative calls in non-uniform WGSL control flow and reject suppression of derivative_uniformity diagnostics.

negativeControls: large-coordinate f32 sphere with a fixed epsilon that collapses the finite-difference gradient to zero
same point with a scale-aware epsilon that recovers a finite normal
EMPTY, FILLED, surface-crossing AMBIGUOUS and maybe-NaN AMBIGUOUS cells
hidden frame-dependent perturbation under nominally frozen inputs
